'''Maya Drin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], during the start of the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. She informed a Republic spacer that Bala D'ur pirates have taken [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] from their homes and turned them into slaves. Eventually, Maya sent the spacer to infiltrate the Bala D'ur's stronghold and free the captive Ortolans.<ref name="TOR" />
